pagination.caveat: Pagination is layout-dependent (renderer, fonts, paper size, field updates). Region-to-page mapping is approximate; reading order and region structure are exact.

conventions.figures: Rule 1 - every image is abstracted to ONE line: "[FIGURE]", "[FIGURE xN]" or "[FIGURE: <caption>]". No pixel content is transcribed. Details live in regions[].figure.
conventions.hierarchy: Rule 2 - layer 1 = pages[], layer 2 = pages[].regions[] (VLM-style block segmentation in reading order). regions[].raw_text holds the raw text of that region.
conventions.continuation: Rule 3 - a block split by a page break keeps one identity via regions[].continuation (flow_id / part / part_count / continues_from / continues_to). flows[] indexes them; topics[] does the same at heading-section level.

regions.raw_text:
XCAL-Mobile is a handheld based stand-alone application running on smart phones that enables QoS and QoE testing across all WCDMA, GSM, LTE, and 5GNR technologies. XCAL-Mobile application on smart phone in Android OS supports extensive application testing and delivers real-time network measurement and visualization.
XCAL-Mobile is provided for both indoor and outdoor measurement while it is also available for field drive test when it is installed inside of a moving vehicle. It supports remote control function by connecting with other server solution series of Accuver. All features can be controlled by using normal handset keys.

regions.raw_text: Precautions of XCAL-Mobile application update(Reinstallation)

When updating the XCAL-Solo application to the latest version, the user must delete the application data only once after the latest version is installed.
If the user deleted the previous version before the version update, there is no need to delete the application data after the version update.
If the application data from the previous version is not deleted, the update might not be applied properly.
(For example, when the unnecessary feature from an older version is deleted in the new version, the new version may still have them.)
The procedure for deleting application data is as follows.

[FIGURE]		[FIGURE]	Deleting application data does not delete previously saved log files and log mask/log data settings.
(Log files and log mask/log data settings are stored separately in the XCAL-Mobile folder of the smartphone's internal storage)
Tap Settings > App Info > XCALv5 > Storage		Tap ‘Clear data’

Or, WiFi information is able to be activated where the upper right of WiFi View.

regions.raw_text: Configuring Logmask

The Logmask setting allows you to monitor the RF parameters to be measured or select the Log Code to be stored.
It is set according to the recommendation(Default), but user can reduce the size of the log file to save and reduce the time of parsing when analyzing by setting the required log code manually.
Log codes list varies depending on the chipset type.

section_path: Creating Autocall Scenario (For Single Call Test)
regions.raw_text:
Before you start Autocall test, you need to pre-configure Autocall scenario (script). Autocall scenario can be configured and edited in App.For Single call Autocall test, XCAL-Mobile processes Autocall test call by call.
XCAL-Mobile supports various call types such as Voice, VoLTE, FTP, HTTP (Web), SMS, WiFi, E-Mail, Ping, YouTube, and ARS-Incoming.

section_path: Creating Autocall Scenario (For Multiple Call Test)
regions.raw_text:
Before you start Autocall test, you need to pre-configure Autocall scenario (script). Autocall scenarios can be configured and edited in App.
Multi-call scenario sequentially runs multiple single scenarios created by technology. That is, a Multi-call scenario is composed of multiple configured single scenarios. Multi-Session and Multi-RAB calls are for a test of multiple single scenarios in parallel, each for up to 5 scenarios and 2 scenarios.

section_path: Creating Autocall Scenario (For Multiple Call Test)
regions.raw_text:
For details on how to configure an Autocall scenario for single call test, see Creating Autocall Scenario (For Single Call Test).
For Multi-Session test, the call types of Voice (VoLTE), YouTube, SMS, and E-Mail can be assigned for only one of the five sessions. The other call types can be assigned for more than one session. Assignment of Voice and VoLTE cannot be overlapped. 
For details on how to assign Autocall scenarios for Multi-Session, see Autocall test for Multiple Call (In Parallel).

regions.raw_text: Terminating Autocall Test

XCAL-Mobile normally terminates an Autocall test automatically when it runs through the whole course of the Autocall scenario (script). However, it can be also be terminated by tapping AUTOCALL STOP button during Autocall measurement.
When it is terminated, Result History screen appears. Tap one of Autocall tests, and then its details are shown. For details, see Call Result History.

regions.raw_text: Monitoring in Digital Map

The collected data and serving lines are visualized in digital map in real-time during the test. Android GPS is used for location information, and the BTS/Repeater data can be also displayed on the map if imported. The digital map is supported in two types; image map and satellite map.
Data is displayed on the digital map greatly depending on the network condition of the mobile phone itself, therefore data is updated more faster in LTE coverage area than in 3G coverage area.

regions.raw_text: Inbuilding test
XCAL-Mobile supports 7 types of Inbuilding measurement.

Configure Inbuilding test
Start Inbuilding test

Moving Point: Run the test on the multiple Bitmap points selected while moving based on the (floor) image loaded.
Fixed Point: Run the test on the fixed Bitmap point based on the (floor) image loaded.
TAB+JPG: Run the test on the multiple GPS points selected while moving based on the TAB/JPG loaded.
Real Time Map: Run the test on the multiple GPS points selected while moving based on Google Map loaded.
Image Real Location: Run the test on the multiple actual GPS points selected while moving based on the loaded JPG mapping coordinates of Google Map.
Pre-Moving: Run the test while moving along the pre-configured points to move.
Motion Tracking: Point the current moving location by using AR feature of the camera while testing.

regions.raw_text: Master/Slave Test

XCAL-Mobile supports Master/Slave feature, in which one Master UE(mobile device) controls up to 3 UEs connected via Bluetooth. In Master/Slave mode, all 4 UEs can start or stop Autocall simultaneously. The log files are separately created, and saved in each UE.
Each slave UE supports all features supported in XCAL-Mobile including Inbuilding feature.

Master/Slave feature runs for authorized license key users only. For an authorized license key, contact to Accuver Support.
Master/Slave function is supported for smartphone models in Android OS version higher than 6.0.
Some mobile models might not be available to connect more than 2 Slave mobiles due to the Bluetooth quality. It is recommended to use Samsung mobile phones for Master device.

regions.raw_text:
[FIGURE: screenshot]
[FIGURE: screenshot]
[FIGURE: screenshot]
[FIGURE: screenshot]	Item	Description
Operation	MOS test is embedded for Voice and VoLTE scenario. To activate/inactivate MOS setting, tap On/Off button for MOS Setting. MOS test is supportable for authorized license key users only.
Installation	Install XCAL-POLQA required for voice MOS tests.
Permission	Allows permissions of XCAL-POLQA required for voice MOS tests.
POLQA V3	MOS Measurement with POLQA V3 POLQA License check: Check the status of OPTICOM's POLQA V3 License. OPTICOM's POLQA V3 license is required for MOS measurements with POLQA V3
M2E Delay	Measurement the M2E(Mouth to Ear) Delay NTP: Using the NTP Server for M2E Delay measurement (Only Support Origination and Termination Call Type) MtoM: Using the Bluetooth for M2E Delay measurement (Only Support MtoM-ORG and MtoM-TER Call Type)
Measurement Type	Select a test type. Simplex(Recording mode): Sound source record test Simplex(Play mode): Sound source play test TimeSync Half-Duplex: Sound source play and record test
Calculation	Select how to calculate the MOS value. NONE (Recording only): Records sound source without calculation of MOS value. POLQA MOS (P.863): Calculates MOS value of receiving sound source in real time based on POLQA algorithm. POLQA Server: The recorded sound source is uploaded to the POLQA Server and calculated by the server using the POLQA algorithm. The POLQA information calculated by the server is passed back to the device.
TimeSync Type	Select time conditions for syncing the start of play and record. NTP Time: Syncs time of play and record based on NTP time. Traffic Time: Syncs time of play and record based on start of Traffic Time. (if it is used Bluetooth connection, automatically Bluetooth time sync)
Original File	Select an original sound source.
Play File	Select a sound source to play.
Add Wave File	Tap Add File button to add the sound source provided by POLQA.
B.Q Threshold	Enter the MOS value that is the standard for Bad Quality (B.Q). If an MOS value lower than the entered value occurs at least once, it is judged as a B.Q result. The B.Q judged by the average value option allows you to apply different judgment criteria.
B.Q judged by the average value	When the average of the measured MOS values is lower than the value entered in B.Q Threshold, it is judged as Bad Quality at Average value (B.Q.A).
C.B.Q Threshold	Configures reference MOS value. When measured MOS value is continuously lower than the configured value, Continuous Bad Quality count is accumulated.
C.B.Q Count	Configures reference count of Continuous Bad Quality. When there are more numbers of Continuous Bad Quality than the configured count, the call is declared as Continuous Bad Quality(CBQ).
M2E BT Delay Threshold	Sets the minimum threshold of delay of Bluetooth connection between mobile and bluetooth module device.
Save Wave Stream to Wave File	Saves received sound source as *.wav.
Save Wave Stream to DRM File	Saves received sound source as *.drm. Directory: /sdcard/XCAL-Mobile/MOSDATA/
Automatic Level Alignment	While calculating MOS value, adjusts volume level of received sound source automatically comparing to reference sound source. (Opticom option)
POLQA TEST	Mobile performs MOS measurement test by playing/recording the sound source by itself.
Play Volume	Controls play volume. MOS volume is controlled in accordance with Attenuation Level in POLQA result of the opposite mobile. [How to control play volume] When Attenuation Level in POLQA result of the opposite mobile is plus (+) value, turn up the play volume. When Attenuation Level in POLQA result of the opposite mobile is minus (-) value, turn down the play volume. For details, see Configuring Play Volume for MOS test.

[FIGURE: screenshot]	Item	Description
FTP	Select a FTP call test type. Down: Data downloading test Up: Data uploading test
Protocol	Select FTP or SFTP.
FTP Server	Loads FTP server information saved in FTP Site Manager.
Passive Mode	Configures in accordance with FTP Server option.
Port	Configures 21 for FTP or 22 for SFTP.
Address	Configures target FTP server address.
User ID	Configures User ID for accessing to FTP server.
Password	Configures password for accessing to FTP server.
Server Path	Configures target directory in FTP server.
File Name	For Download test: Configures name of original file to be downloaded from FTP server. For Upload test: Configures file size to be uploaded. unit: K (Kbyte), M (Mbyte), G (GByte) ex) 100k, 10m, 10g
Check FTP Server	Clicks Check button to check if FTP server is properly connected.
Multi-Thread Session	Configure number of session to open.
Upload File Delete	Delete an uploaded file on FTP server when FTP uploading test is completed.
Upload payload randomized	To Randomize the file to upload.
Pending	On: When data throughput satisfies the user-configured Pending conditions, the current call is terminated and the next call is started automatically. Interval: If the throughput value remains under the configured threshold value for the configured interval period, Pending event is declared and the call is terminated. Threshold: The desired throughput value in kbps. If throughput remains under the configured threshold value for the configured interval period, Pending event is declared and the call is terminated.
FTP NT	On: When FTP network throughput satisfies the configured condition, it is declared as Success. When FTP network throughput does not satisfy the configured condition, it is declared as Low Throughput. Ref.Thro: Configures minimum data throughput allowing network throughput Start Time: Configures delay after Traffic Start which measures network throughput End Event: When this option is set to On and there is a Drop/Pending/Success event occurring in Traffic Time, call test is terminated automatically.
Network Changed	When the NetworkChanged option is selected, if the smartphone is connected to a network type that is not the type you were measuring during the test, the call is determined to be Drop and the next call is initiated.
Ignore Call Drop (For Dual SIM)	Even if the socket is closed, the drop does not occur for as long as the time set in the option, and if the socket is reconnected within the time, traffic is maintained. This option is only active when the Dual SIM option is turned on.

XCAL-WebView App Info: Open the App info window. You can set permissions manually. If XCAL-WebView is not installed or no permission is given, Autocall will not properly run.

Network Thp	On: When HTTP throughput satisfies the configured condition, it declares as Success. When HTTP throughput does not satisfy the configured condition, it declares as Low Throughput. If ‘DROP’ occurs, the call is terminated without running out of traffic time even if this option is not used.
Repeat	On: When Repeat is On, it takes the action as many times as the count within the traffic time. Repeat Count: The number of times to take an action. Repeat Delay: Each action waits for the time set in Delay before proceeding.
Page Display Time	The time between the two URL, when first URL is browse complete wait for page display time , later the second URL is proceed.
Socket Error Count	When a socket error (EAGAIN; Error code is 11.) message is issued, it will be delayed by the number of times set. If the error message comes less than the set number, it is regarded as normal operation and the call continues.
Socket Timeout	If the socket error code is not received from the server and the time set in the HTTP session is exceeded, the socket is determined to be closed. It may be different from the Socket Timeout (sec) time set because the call is declared after waiting for the time given by the socket.
Ignore Call Drop (For Dual SIM)	Even if the socket is closed, the drop does not occur for as long as the time set in the option, and if the socket is reconnected within the time, traffic is maintained. This option is only active when the Dual SIM option is turned on.

Time Out (s)	Configure delay time to restart web loading.
URL	Configure web page address.
XCAL-WebView	Installation: Check installation of XCAL-WebView. If it is installed, you can install it. Permission: Get permission for accessibility using XCAL-Webview. XCAL-WebView App Info: Open the App info window. You can set permissions manually. If XCAL-WebView is not installed or no permission is given, Autocall will not properly run.
Traffic Start Condition	- First payload: After receiving a response from the test web server, check the first payload to start traffic time. - URL Request: After sending the request to the web server, traffic starts without checking the response to the request.
Upload Type	Select Post or Get.
HTTP File Size	For HTTP Upload test, configure the file size to be uploaded. Unit: k/K (Kbyte), m/M (Mbyte), g/G (GByte)
Pending	On: When data throughput satisfies the user-configured Pending conditions, the current call is terminated and the next call is started automatically. Interval: If the throughput value remains under the configured threshold value for the configured interval period, Pending event is declared and the call is terminated. Threshold: The desired throughput value in kbps. If throughput remains under the configured threshold value for the configured interval period, Pending event is declared and the call is terminated.
Network Thp	On: When HTTP throughput satisfies the configured condition, it declares as Success. When HTTP throughput does not satisfy the configured condition, it declares as Low Throughput. Start Time: Configures delay after Traffic Start which measures network throughput Call End: When this option is set to On and there is a Drop/Pending/Success event occurring in Traffic Time, call test is terminated automatically. If ‘DROP’ occurs, the call is terminated without running out of traffic time even if this option is not used.
Repeat	On: When Repeat is On, it takes the action as many times as the count within the traffic time. Repeat Count: The number of times to take an action. Repeat Delay: Each action waits for the time set in Delay before proceeding.
Page Display Time	The time between the two URL, when first URL is browse complete wait for page display time , later the second URL is proceed.
Socket Error Count	When a socket error (EAGAIN; Error code is 11.) message is issued, it will be delayed by the number of times set. If the error message comes less than the set number, it is regarded as normal operation and the call continues.
Socket Timeout	If the socket error code is not received from the server and the time set in the HTTP session is exceeded, the socket is determined to be closed. It may be different from the Socket Timeout (sec) time set because the call is declared after waiting for the time given by the socket.
Ignore Call Drop (For Dual SIM)	Even if the socket is closed, the drop does not occur for as long as the time set in the option, and if the socket is reconnected within the time, traffic is maintained. This option is only active when the Dual SIM option is turned on.

Packet Capture (VPN)	-When the Packet Capture(VPN) option is selected, select the Packet capture byte size 100, 200, 1500, 6566 Byte. -Check the XCAL-VPCAP Installation, Notice pop-up allow it to ok and proceed.

[FIGURE: screenshot]	Multi Call test enables you to carry out call tests based on multiple call scenarios sequentially.
(Multi-call does not support MtoM Voice/VoLTE measurements)
Tap New button, and input a new call name in the entry field.

Select the scenarios saved in the Call Scenario list, click Add button to add them in Selected Scenario list at the bottom.
The order of scenarios can be changed by dragging each scenario in Select Scenario screen.
Network Lock scenario setting is the same as Select Autocall Scenario
Configure how many times you want to repeat multi-call test in Repeat Count entry field.
Per Scenario: Tap to select On to create a log file (*.drm) for respective call scenarios.
Per Repeat: To create a log file per repeat time of Multi-call.
Check the Airplane mode(Before Multi-Call) option.
Tap Save button.
Tap Delete button to delete the current Multi-Call scenario.
Tap Start button in main screen to start multi call test.
For details on how to configure options of multi-call test, see Autocall Test for Sequential Multiple Calls (Multi-Call).
Call start is only possible when Total time for all scenarios is ON or OFF.

regions.raw_text: Multi-RAB

[FIGURE x2: screenshot]	Multi RAB test enables you to carry out voice and data call test concurrently.
6 types of autocalls are available - Voice, VoLTE, HTTP, FTP, Ping, E-mail.
Select the type of RAB you want to test.
Sync: Starts next call when one session (Voice + Data call) is ended.
Random Delay: Applied when the second call starts after the first call starts. (More than 5secs)
Not applied with ’Set 2nd call start’ option at the same time.
Set 2nd call start : Available to set the second call start time(sec) based on the first call time.
Async: Processes voice and data call individually.

regions.raw_text: Multi-Session

[FIGURE: screenshot]	Multi-Session test enables you to carry out call tests for up to five calls at the same time.
Sync: Start next call for every session that is completed.
If Total Time is set to 0, Sync measurement is performed without Total Time.
Async: Session are processed individually.
Only one call type among Voice, YouTube, SMS, and E-Mail can be assigned throughout the five sessions. The other call types can be assigned for more than one session.
The call type of Voice or VoLTE should be assigned for the first session.
